response.sql: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE CAST(oe.expirespot AS TEXT) > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND CAST(oe.expirespot AS TEXT) < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY u.acctscope

assumptions.assumption: Inner joins from orderexecutions to orders to users; executions without a matching order or user are excluded, as the request states.
expirespot is compared as text with strict inequalities, as the request states; executions with NULL expirespot are excluded.
Each execution row is counted once (COUNT(*)), grouped by acctscope; users with a NULL acctscope would appear as a NULL group.
